HOW TO READ THIS REPORT

The boundaries of the audit.

Findings are evidence for review. A static check can identify a discrepancy without proving what happens at runtime.

01 / SOURCE

A fixed point of reference.

GitHub evidence points to the recorded commit and exact source lines. Uncommitted changes are not included.

02 / SCOPE

Public Lua, with limits.

Sandbox, TTT, and menu-only APIs are excluded; the base gamemode and other Lua files remain included. Missing-page candidates exclude metamethods, private helpers, locals, instance callbacks, ordinary fields, and unresolved dynamic exports. Canonical and inherited documentation covers overrides. Prefix and limit options restrict coverage.

03 / INTERPRETATION

Uncertainty stays visible.

Contracts account for method self, varargs, overloads, and optional returns. Dynamic returns and uncertain control flow remain inconclusive. Realm traces establish static load paths, not runtime behavior or the absence of other routes. Failed and unresolved checks are never clean results.

Engine roots and realm constants follow the official Lua loading order, States / Realms, and Global Variables references.
